summary: Alone in an empty office, Neo is guided by Morpheus over the phone. Morpheus tells him there is a scaffold outside and a window he should open; once opened, "The WIND HOWLS into the room." Morpheus instructs him to use the scaffold to reach the roof, but Neo refuses: "No! It's too far away." Morpheus insists there is a ledge and "a short short climb," and frames the choice as binary: the scaffold, or being taken into custody — "You take a chance either way. I leave it to you." He hangs up. Neo protests his innocence and insignificance, then climbs onto the ledge and out onto the narrow ledge, where "The scaffold seems even farther away." A sudden blast of wind knocks him off balance; he clings to the frame and the phone falls, swallowed by the distance below. Panicked, Neo declares "This is insane! I can't do this! Forget it!" and climbs back into the office — "just as a cop opens the door," prompting Neo's final "Shit!"

what_changes.before: Refusing the escape entirely, insisting the scaffold is unreachable.
what_changes.after: Commits to the climb, stepping out onto the narrow ledge despite terror.
what_changes.evidence: He climbs up onto the window ledge. Hanging onto the frame, he steps onto the small ledge. The scaffold seems even farther away.

what_changes.before: On the ledge, he attempts the crossing.
what_changes.after: The wind blasts him off balance and he abandons the attempt, retreating back inside.
what_changes.evidence: This is insane! I can't do this! Forget it! He climbs back into the office just as a cop opens the door.

what_changes.before: Safe indoors, weighing two exits Morpheus has laid out.
what_changes.after: Exposed on the ledge and then trapped again as a cop enters the room.
what_changes.evidence: Neo looks down; the building's glass wall vertigos into a concrete chasm.

what_changes.before: Demands to understand how Morpheus knows the building's layout.
what_changes.after: Told the explanation is coming, and left to act on faith.
what_changes.evidence: NEO / How do you know all this? ... MORPHEUS (V.O.) / The answer is coming, Neo.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus guides Neo's escape out of the office building via a window ledge toward a scaffold.

uncertain: Whether Neo ultimately reaches the scaffold or roof — the scene ends with him back inside as a cop enters.
The time of day, and whether the 'cop' is connected to the Agents seen in sc-017.

minds.wants: To be told he is safe — to have the terror of the situation explained and resolved by an external authority rather than having to act on faith.
minds.feels: Raw, escalating panic that has tipped past the point of reasoning. He is not weighing options; he is drowning in them, and the physical exposure on the ledge makes abstract fear literal.
minds.shows: He argues, protests his innocence ("I'm nobody. I didn't do anything"), and only moves when there is no one left arguing with him — then immediately retreats the moment the wind hits him.
minds.basis: He asks 'How do you know all this?' and 'Why is this happening to me? What did I do?' — demands for explanation, not action. He climbs out only after Morpheus hangs up and leaves him alone with the choice, and climbs back in the instant the wind blasts him. The event shape (captured after this scene) confirms he does not make the crossing.

believes_about.belief: That Morpheus is either a dangerous madman or a cruel prankster subjecting him to something insane and unjust.
believes_about.wrong_because: Morpheus is guiding a genuine escape from the Agents; the 'insanity' is real danger, not malice, and Morpheus's promise ('The answer is coming') is literal — but Neo cannot yet tell the difference.

believes_about.belief: That he is insignificant — 'I'm nobody' — and therefore undeserving of being hunted and incapable of surviving this.
believes_about.wrong_because: The entire pursuit is premised on him being someone specific ('The One'); his self-image as a nobody is the last shield of his ordinary life, and it is about to be systematically dismantled.

minds.wants: To get Neo out of the building by forcing him to choose and then removing the option of not choosing.
minds.feels: A controlled, almost serene urgency — he is operating a plan that is running out of time, and he treats Neo's terror as a variable to be managed, not soothed.
minds.shows: A quiet laugh, cryptic deferral ('The answer is coming'), and a binary ultimatum delivered as if it were a gift of freedom ('I leave it to you') — then he hangs up rather than negotiate.
minds.basis: He laughs when asked how he knows the layout, refuses to reassure Neo, reframes an impossible-seeming climb as 'a short short climb,' and deliberately ends the call at the moment of decision so Neo cannot lean on him. His guidance in sc-017 established the same pattern: command, not comfort.

believes_about.belief: That Neo 'can make it' — that he has, latent in him, the capacity to do this and more.
believes_about.wrong_because: In the immediate sense he is wrong: Neo fails the climb and is captured. But the belief is about a larger capacity Neo does not yet possess, so it is a faith placed ahead of the evidence, not a reading of the present moment.

connects_back: sc-017: Morpheus's phone-guided escape and the established command-and-obey dynamic; the Agents and cops are the same pursuers now closing in.
sc-016: The scaffold/window-cleaning platform Neo stared at while Rhineheart lectured him — the physical escape route is the same object he was already fixated on.

sc-016: Rhineheart's accusation that Neo 'believes he is special, that the rules do not apply' — the irony that he is, in fact, being hunted precisely because he is special, which Neo cannot yet know.
sets_up: ev-003: Neo's failure to cross and his retreat back into the office places him directly in the path of the cop, making his capture and subsequent interrogation by Agent Smith inevitable.
ev-004: The withheld 'answer' and the trauma of this failed escape set the psychological and narrative conditions for Morpheus's later revelation that Neo is 'The One.'
ev-006 / ev-008: This is the last moment of Neo's ordinary life before capture, unplugging, and physical modification — the end of the world he still believes he is 'nobody' in.
dramatic_function: This is the trap snapping shut: it converts the abstract threat of the Agents into immediate physical peril, tests Neo against his own fear, and — by having him fail the test — drives him into capture, which is the necessary turn that moves the story from pursuit to revelation.
